info.title: NPS Indore portal API
info.description: Backend API for the NPS Indore member portal. Errors are always `{ "error": "message" }`.

bearer.description: Session token (also sent as the httpOnly npsi_session cookie)

recaptchaToken.description: Google reCAPTCHA v3 token (required when the server has a secret configured)

email.description: Email or mobile; `phone` or `username` are accepted too

password.description: Temporary password, also emailed to the user

photoUrl.description: Profile photo: a URL returned by POST /uploads

family.description: The member's ACTIVE family (by email), or the family they are listed in

members.description: Members of that family, oldest first

student.description: The member's own student record, if any

taken.description: true when the value is already registered

file.description: JPEG, PNG, WEBP or GIF image, max 5 MB

fileUrl.description: Public URL of the stored image

remarks.description: Required to reject or ask for a correction; shown to the applicant
